content:
Response
Meaning
200
The integration was modified successfully. Also returns the integration
object (see Retrieve Integration by Integration Key).
400
Invalid or missing parameters, one-to-many object limit reached, an
integration already exists with the given name , insufficient Admin API
permissions, or attempting to reset the secret key used to sign this API
request.
404
No integration was found with the given integration_key .
500
Other internal error.
